nodes.comment: TLF: learn to predict reward from context
nodes.requirement: Requirement of [R.Reward-Prediction-Error-Learning] using [U.VTA] (reward prediction error) and [U.NAC] (state value).
nodes.requirementRealization: The interface receives [U.A9/46d(left)] and emits [U.Arc]; [U.VTA] and [U.NAC] close the learning loop.
nodes.mechanism: Dopamine-gated plasticity updates values until the prediction error vanishes.
